+from AlgorithmImports import *
+
+
+class IndependentSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
+    SMA_PERIOD = 20
+    RSI_PERIOD = 14
+
+    def Initialize(self):
+        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
+        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
+        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
+
+        self.symbols = {}
+        for ticker in ("SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"):
+            security = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily)
+            self.symbols[ticker] = security.Symbol
+
+        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(self.SMA_PERIOD)
+        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(
+            self.RSI_PERIOD, MovingAverageType.Wilders
+        )
+
+        self.spy_lot = 0
+        self.aapl_lot = 0
+
+        self.previous_spy_close = None
+        self.previous_spy_sma = None
+        self.previous_aapl_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+
+        self.SetWarmUp(self.SMA_PERIOD, Resolution.Daily)
+
+    def OnData(self, data):
+        spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
+        aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]
+
+        spy_bar = data.Bars[spy] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(spy) else None
+        aapl_bar = data.Bars[aapl] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(aapl) else None
+
+        if spy_bar is not None:
+            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
+
+        if aapl_bar is not None:
+            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)
+            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
+                if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+                else:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
+
+        all_bars_present = all(
+            data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()
+        )
+        indicators_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
+
+        if (
+            not self.IsWarmingUp
+            and all_bars_present
+            and indicators_ready
+            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
+            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
+        ):
+            spy_crossed_above = (
+                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
+                and spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
+            )
+            spy_crossed_below = (
+                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
+                and spy_bar.Close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
+            )
+
+            # All sells are evaluated before either independent slot can buy.
+            if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
+                self.MarketOrder(spy, -self.spy_lot)
+                self.spy_lot = 0
+
+            if self.aapl_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
+                self.MarketOrder(aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
+                self.aapl_lot = 0
+
+            if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
+                quantity = int(
+                    (self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * Decimal("0.40"))
+                    // spy_bar.Close
+                )
+                if quantity > 0:
+                    self.MarketOrder(spy, quantity)
+                    self.spy_lot = quantity
+
+            if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
+                cash_to_invest = Decimal("20000")
+                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= cash_to_invest:
+                    quantity = int(cash_to_invest // aapl_bar.Close)
+                    if quantity > 0:
+                        self.MarketOrder(aapl, quantity)
+                        self.aapl_lot = quantity
+
+        if spy_bar is not None and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
+            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
+            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

+from AlgorithmImports import *
+from collections import deque
+from math import floor
+
+
+class ParallelSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
+    SMA_PERIOD = 20
+    RSI_PERIOD = 14
+
+    def Initialize(self):
+        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
+        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
+        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
+
+        self.symbols = {}
+        for ticker in ("SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"):
+            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
+
+        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=self.SMA_PERIOD + 1)
+        self.aapl_previous_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(
+            self.RSI_PERIOD, MovingAverageType.Wilders
+        )
+
+        self.spy_lot = 0
+        self.aapl_lot = 0
+
+    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
+        spy_crossed_above = False
+        spy_crossed_below = False
+        spy_close = None
+        if self.symbols["SPY"] in data.Bars:
+            spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.symbols["SPY"]].Close)
+            self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)
+            if len(self.spy_closes) == self.SMA_PERIOD + 1:
+                closes = list(self.spy_closes)
+                yesterday_sma = sum(closes[:-1]) / self.SMA_PERIOD
+                today_sma = sum(closes[1:]) / self.SMA_PERIOD
+                spy_crossed_above = (
+                    closes[-2] <= yesterday_sma and closes[-1] > today_sma
+                )
+                spy_crossed_below = (
+                    closes[-2] >= yesterday_sma and closes[-1] < today_sma
+                )
+
+        aapl_close = None
+        if self.symbols["AAPL"] in data.Bars:
+            aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.symbols["AAPL"]].Close)
+            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
+                if aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+                else:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close
+            self.aapl_rsi.Update(data.Time, aapl_close)
+
+        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
+            return
+
+        # Evaluate every sell before either strategy's buy.
+        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
+            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], -self.spy_lot)
+            self.spy_lot = 0
+
+        if (
+            self.aapl_lot > 0
+            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
+            and float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60
+        ):
+            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.aapl_lot)
+            self.aapl_lot = 0
+
+        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
+            quantity = floor(0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close)
+            if quantity > 0:
+                self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], quantity)
+                self.spy_lot = quantity
+
+        if (
+            self.aapl_lot == 0
+            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
+            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
+            and float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20_000
+        ):
+            quantity = floor(20_000 / aapl_close)
+            if quantity > 0:
+                self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], quantity)
+                self.aapl_lot = quantity

@@ -0,0 +1,138 @@
+from AlgorithmImports import *
+
+
+class ParallelSpyAaplStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
+    """Two independent, privately accounted daily equity strategies."""
+
+    SMA_PERIOD = 20
+
+    def initialize(self):
+        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
+        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
+        self.set_cash(1_000_000)
+
+        self.symbols = {}
+        for ticker in ("SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"):
+            self.symbols[ticker] = self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY).symbol
+
+        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(self.SMA_PERIOD)
+        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS)
+
+        self.previous_spy_close = None
+        self.previous_spy_sma = None
+        self.previous_aapl_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+
+        self.spy_lot = 0
+        self.aapl_lot = 0
+        self.spy_order_pending = False
+        self.aapl_order_pending = False
+        self.order_strategy = {}
+
+    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
+        spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
+        aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]
+
+        spy_bar = data.bars[spy] if data.bars.contains_key(spy) else None
+        aapl_bar = data.bars[aapl] if data.bars.contains_key(aapl) else None
+
+        spy_previous_close = self.previous_spy_close
+        spy_previous_sma = self.previous_spy_sma
+
+        if spy_bar is not None:
+            self.spy_sma.update(spy_bar.end_time, spy_bar.close)
+
+        if aapl_bar is not None:
+            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
+                if aapl_bar.close < self.previous_aapl_close:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+                else:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            self.aapl_rsi.update(aapl_bar.end_time, aapl_bar.close)
+            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.close
+
+        if spy_bar is not None:
+            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.close
+            self.previous_spy_sma = (
+                self.spy_sma.current.value if self.spy_sma.is_ready else None
+            )
+
+        # A missing daily bar for any subscription suppresses every rule today.
+        if any(not data.bars.contains_key(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
+            return
+
+        if not self.spy_sma.is_ready or not self.aapl_rsi.is_ready:
+            return
+
+        spy_crossed_below = (
+            spy_previous_close is not None
+            and spy_previous_sma is not None
+            and spy_previous_close >= spy_previous_sma
+            and spy_bar.close < self.spy_sma.current.value
+        )
+
+        # All sells are evaluated before either strategy's buy.
+        if self.spy_lot > 0 and not self.spy_order_pending and spy_crossed_below:
+            self._submit_lot_order(spy, -self.spy_lot, "spy")
+
+        if (
+            self.aapl_lot > 0
+            and not self.aapl_order_pending
+            and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60
+        ):
+            self._submit_lot_order(aapl, -self.aapl_lot, "aapl")
+
+        spy_crossed_above = (
+            spy_previous_close is not None
+            and spy_previous_sma is not None
+            and spy_previous_close <= spy_previous_sma
+            and spy_bar.close > self.spy_sma.current.value
+        )
+        if self.spy_lot == 0 and not self.spy_order_pending and spy_crossed_above:
+            target_value = self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40
+            quantity = int(target_value / spy_bar.close)
+            if quantity > 0:
+                self._submit_lot_order(spy, quantity, "spy")
+
+        if (
+            self.aapl_lot == 0
+            and not self.aapl_order_pending
+            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
+            and self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000
+        ):
+            quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_bar.close)
+            if quantity > 0:
+                self._submit_lot_order(aapl, quantity, "aapl")
+
+    def _submit_lot_order(self, symbol: Symbol, quantity: int, strategy: str):
+        ticket = self.market_order(symbol, quantity, tag=f"{strategy} private lot")
+        self.order_strategy[ticket.order_id] = strategy
+        if strategy == "spy":
+            self.spy_order_pending = True
+        else:
+            self.aapl_order_pending = True
+
+    def on_order_event(self, order_event: OrderEvent):
+        strategy = self.order_strategy.get(order_event.order_id)
+        if strategy is None:
+            return
+
+        if order_event.status in (OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED, OrderStatus.FILLED):
+            filled = int(order_event.fill_quantity)
+            if strategy == "spy":
+                self.spy_lot += filled
+            else:
+                self.aapl_lot += filled
+
+        if order_event.status in (
+            OrderStatus.FILLED,
+            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
+            OrderStatus.INVALID,
+        ):
+            if strategy == "spy":
+                self.spy_order_pending = False
+                self.spy_lot = max(0, self.spy_lot)
+            else:
+                self.aapl_order_pending = False
+                self.aapl_lot = max(0, self.aapl_lot)
+            del self.order_strategy[order_event.order_id]

+from AlgorithmImports import *
+
+
+class IndependentSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
+    SMA_PERIOD = 20
+    RSI_PERIOD = 14
+
+    def initialize(self):
+        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
+        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
+        self.set_cash(1_000_000)
+
+        self.symbols = {}
+        for ticker in ("SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"):
+            self.symbols[ticker] = self.add_equity(
+                ticker, Resolution.DAILY
+            ).symbol
+
+        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
+        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]
+
+        self.spy_sma = self.sma(self.spy, self.SMA_PERIOD, Resolution.DAILY)
+        self.aapl_rsi = self.rsi(
+            self.aapl,
+            self.RSI_PERIOD,
+            MovingAverageType.WILDERS,
+            Resolution.DAILY,
+        )
+
+        self.spy_lot = 0
+        self.aapl_lot = 0
+        self.previous_spy_close = None
+        self.previous_spy_sma = None
+        self.previous_aapl_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+
+        self.set_warm_up(max(self.SMA_PERIOD, self.RSI_PERIOD), Resolution.DAILY)
+
+    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
+        bars = data.bars
+        all_bars_present = all(
+            symbol in bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()
+        )
+
+        spy_bar = bars[self.spy] if self.spy in bars else None
+        aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl] if self.aapl in bars else None
+
+        if aapl_bar is not None:
+            if (
+                self.previous_aapl_close is not None
+                and aapl_bar.close < self.previous_aapl_close
+            ):
+                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+            else:
+                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.close
+
+        spy_crosses_above = False
+        spy_crosses_below = False
+        if spy_bar is not None and self.spy_sma.is_ready:
+            current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value
+            if (
+                self.previous_spy_close is not None
+                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
+            ):
+                spy_crosses_above = (
+                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
+                    and spy_bar.close > current_spy_sma
+                )
+                spy_crosses_below = (
+                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
+                    and spy_bar.close < current_spy_sma
+                )
+            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.close
+            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
+
+        if (
+            self.is_warming_up
+            or not all_bars_present
+            or not self.spy_sma.is_ready
+            or not self.aapl_rsi.is_ready
+        ):
+            return
+
+        # Both independent strategies evaluate their sell before their buy.
+        if self.spy_lot > 0:
+            if spy_crosses_below:
+                self.market_order(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
+                self.spy_lot = 0
+        elif spy_crosses_above:
+            target_value = self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40
+            quantity = int(target_value // spy_bar.close)
+            if quantity > 0:
+                self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
+                self.spy_lot = quantity
+
+        if self.aapl_lot > 0:
+            if self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60:
+                self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
+                self.aapl_lot = 0
+        elif self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000:
+            quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_bar.close)
+            if quantity > 0:
+                self.market_order(self.aapl, quantity)
+                self.aapl_lot = quantity

+    RSI_PERIOD = 14

+        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(

+            self.RSI_PERIOD,
+            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
+            Resolution.Daily,
+        )
+
+        self.previous_closes = {}
+        self.previous_spy_above_sma = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+
+        self.spy_lot = 0
+        self.aapl_lot = 0
+

+        bars = data.Bars
+

+        aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]
+        if aapl in bars:
+            aapl_close = bars[aapl].Close
+            previous_aapl_close = self.previous_closes.get(aapl)
+            if previous_aapl_close is None:

+            elif aapl_close < previous_aapl_close:

+            self.previous_closes[aapl] = aapl_close

+        spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
+        current_spy_above_sma = None
+        if spy in bars and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
+            current_spy_above_sma = bars[spy].Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
+
+        complete_slice = all(symbol in bars for symbol in self.symbols.values())

+
+        self.spy_lot = 0
+        self.aapl_lot = 0

+        aapl_bar = bars[aapl] if bars.contains_key(aapl) else None
+

+        spy_crossed_below = False

+            if self.previous_spy_close is not None and self.previous_spy_sma is not None:
+                spy_crossed_above = (

+                spy_crossed_below = (
+                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
+                    and spy_bar.close < current_sma

+            self.previous_spy_sma = current_sma

+        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy not in self.pending_orders and spy_crossed_below:

+        if (

+            and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60
+        ):

+            self.pending_orders[aapl] = ticket.order_id
+
+        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy not in self.pending_orders and spy_crossed_above:
+            quantity = int((self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40) // spy_bar.close)
+            if quantity > 0:
+                ticket = self.market_order(spy, quantity)
+                self.pending_orders[spy] = ticket.order_id
+
+        if (
+            self.aapl_lot == 0
+            and aapl not in self.pending_orders
+            and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
+            and self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000
+        ):
+            quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_bar.close)
+            if quantity > 0:
+                ticket = self.market_order(aapl, quantity)
+                self.pending_orders[aapl] = ticket.order_id
+
+    def on_order_event(self, order_event: OrderEvent):
+        if order_event.status not in (OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED, OrderStatus.FILLED):
+            if order_event.status in (OrderStatus.CANCELED, OrderStatus.INVALID):
+                self.pending_orders.pop(order_event.symbol, None)
+            return
+
+        if order_event.symbol == self.symbols["SPY"]:
+            self.spy_lot += int(order_event.fill_quantity)
+        elif order_event.symbol == self.symbols["AAPL"]:
+            self.aapl_lot += int(order_event.fill_quantity)
+
+        if order_event.status == OrderStatus.FILLED:
+            self.pending_orders.pop(order_event.symbol, None)

from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque
from math import floor


class IndependentSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
    SMA_PERIOD = 20
    RSI_PERIOD = 14

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ("SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"):
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(self.SMA_PERIOD)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(
            self.RSI_PERIOD, MovingAverageType.Wilders
        )
        self.aapl_closes = deque(maxlen=4)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        complete_slice = all(
            data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols.values()
        )
        spy_bar = (
            data.Bars[self.symbols["SPY"]]
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.symbols["SPY"])
            else None
        )
        aapl_bar = (
            data.Bars[self.symbols["AAPL"]]
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.symbols["AAPL"])
            else None
        )

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)
            self.aapl_closes.append(float(aapl_bar.Close))

        # Market-state series continue to consume their available bars, but no rule
        # is evaluated unless all five subscriptions supplied today's bar.
        if not complete_slice:
            if spy_bar is not None:
                self.previous_spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
                self.previous_spy_sma = (
                    float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value) if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
                )
            return

        spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
        aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

        spy_history_ready = (
            self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
        )
        aapl_red_history_ready = len(self.aapl_closes) == 4

        spy_crossed_above = (
            spy_history_ready
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        )
        spy_crossed_below = (
            spy_history_ready
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )
        aapl_red_three_days = (
            aapl_red_history_ready
            and self.aapl_closes[-1] < self.aapl_closes[-2]
            and self.aapl_closes[-2] < self.aapl_closes[-3]
            and self.aapl_closes[-3] < self.aapl_closes[-4]
        )

        # Sells are evaluated before either strategy's buy.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if (
            self.strategy_b_shares > 0
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60
        ):
            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
            quantity = self.CalculateOrderQuantity(self.symbols["SPY"], 0.40)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], quantity)
                self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and aapl_red_three_days:
            allocation = 20_000
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= allocation:
                quantity = floor(allocation / aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
